method.declared: 2026-11-14T05:12+04:00, before any Tonle Sap radar file was read
method.inputs: NISAR L2 GCOV, track 083, ascending, frame 008, mode 2005, every finished pass
method.speckle_filter: k x k block mean in linear power, k = round(60 m / native pixel spacing) -> ~60 m pixels
method.forest_at_start: first pass (19 Jun): HV >= -16 dB and not open water (radar-only, declared)
method.flooded_forest: forest-at-start pixel with HH >= -5 dB on that pass (trunk-water double bounce)
method.check: NASA OPERA DSWx-S1 (GIBS WMS layer OPERA_L3_Dynamic_Surface_Water_Extent-Sentinel-1), nearest date within +/-6 days with >= 50% of the box valid (tie -> earlier), sampled at our pixel centres
method.dswx_colour_table: GIBS colormap OPERA_Dynamic_Surface_Water_Extent_S1.xml v1.3: 255,255,255 = 0 not water; 0,0,255 = 1 open water; 0,255,0 = 3 inundated vegetation; 200,200,200 = 250 HAND masked; 128,128,128 = 251 layover/shadow masked; transparent = no data
method.agreement: % of pixels (both valid, DSWx class 0/1/3) where NISAR open water and DSWx class 1 give the same yes/no; IoU and both one-way shares also reported
method.missed: NISAR flooded forest where DSWx-S1 says 0 (not water)
method.badge_rule: Open water: Strong if agreement >= 80% on >= 2 dates, Moderate if >= 80% on 1 date, Weak otherwise. Case badge capped at Moderate: flooded forest is L-band only by definition (no independent check)
method.rain: NASA POWER daily PRECTOTCORR at the box centre (12.80 N, 104.20 E), 1 May -> today; regional, not per field

other_sources.check: NASA OPERA DSWx-S1 via GIBS WMS (OPERA_L3_Dynamic_Surface_Water_Extent-Sentinel-1)
other_sources.mekong: Chua et al. 2022, Hydrol. Earth Syst. Sci. 26:609-625, doi:10.5194/hess-26-609-2022
